old_problem: The six-window procedure covers only a possible MaxSess boundary and gives no idle-timeout step; actual limit/scope, keepalive semantics, rejection stage and timeout/grace values are project parameters.
disposition_reason: The title/Criteria explicitly authorize both independent checks. decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2254 and 2255, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical record and unique identity were reviewed.

test_case.test_name: Bounded BMC SSH MaxSess admission and SessTimeOut closure
test_case.purpose: Validate the product-specified maximum BMC SSH session boundary and independent idle-session timeout while preserving unrelated management access.
required_package: BMC/SSH build and signed MaxSess/SessTimeOut values
Policy scope and existing/control-session counting rule
Dedicated account, rejection stage, idle/keepalive/grace semantics
Independent recovery path and marked-session cleanup plan
test_case.test_command: After approval, inventory sessions; open uniquely marked SSH sessions only through policy boundary plus one (including the source six-window point) and record each connection stage. Separately hold one accepted marked session truly idle with keepalives configured per policy until server closure/timeout, then close all marked sessions and reconcile baseline.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly the approved number/scope of sessions reaches the defined acceptance stage, boundary-plus-one is rejected as specified, and the isolated idle session is server-closed within the approved timeout/grace while active control and unrelated sessions remain healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed values/scope plus exact boundary and idle-close timing evidence for both subtests and complete cleanup. Missing runtime policy blocks execution, not review. Wrong admission count/stage, premature/late/no close, resource fault or unrelated-session impact is FAIL.
safety_gate: Explicit bounded-session approval and independent recovery channel.
Dedicated account and accounting of existing sessions.
Never exceed boundary plus one or auto-retry lockout.
Close only marked test sessions; stop on latency/resource/auth anomalies.
expected_evidence: Marked cleanup, unrelated-session invariance and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop new sessions on any BMC degradation or lockout, preserve connection/server evidence, close only marked sessions through the independent channel and escalate without retry.
